name: Zecchou! Soku Iki! Tanetsuke Netori Ryokan e Youkoso! ~Toukan wa Okyakusama no Ninshin o 100％ Hoshou Shimasu~
original_name: 絶頂！即イキ！種付け寝取り旅館へようこそ！ ～当館はお客様の妊娠を100％保証します～
source:
A secluded, rundown inn in a remote area.
It is said that a persistent rumor keeps attracting new customers.

The rumor is that it is an inn for those who wish "to be blessed with children."
If you bring your boyfriend without telling him, it is also said to bring good fortune for matchmaking.

The truth behind this blessing is... a special service for female guests.

The stuff uses surveillance cameras to catch wives away from their husbands or collectively violates someone's girlfriends in the female bath...

It is to this inn that a beautiful biker, 'Suzuki Ame,' arrives with her boyfriend.

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ014029.html]the dlsite[/url]]
translation:
位于偏远地区的一家僻静、破旧的旅馆。
据说，持续不断的谣言不断吸引着新顾客。

传闻这是一家为那些希望“多子多福”的人而设的旅馆。
如果瞒着男朋友带上，据说还能带来姻缘。

这个祝福背后的真相是……针对女性客人的特殊服务。

这些东西利用监控摄像头将妻子从丈夫身边带走，或者在女浴池里集体侵犯某人的女朋友……

美丽的摩托车手“铃木雨”和她的男朋友来到了这家旅馆。
